text:
Drew O'Connor's season has been the kind that gets your name into trade columns. Vancouver has lost game after game, he has 5 points in 20, and in early November Canucks Army ran "Canucks coach Manny Malhotra calls out Drew O'Connor's penalty troubles" while Pro Hockey Rumors and Vancouver Hockey Daily floated him as a trade target. The Hockey News wrote that he is "Focused On Turning His Season Around".

Some of it is not on him. With O'Connor on the ice the Canucks have scored 4.41 fewer goals than their chances deserved, and he is shooting 7.7% against a 12.6% midpoint in our range. His 3.21 expected goals have turned into 2 goals. But the process is not great either: Vancouver has had 41.9% of the five-on-five expected goals with him out there. He still has tools teams like, a 6'4" frame, speed in the 96th percentile and a hard shot. The finishing should come back some. Whether the minutes stay is the real question.
headline: Drew O'Connor is trying to turn a hard start around
